_about: Round 8 (2026-11-25): smoother transitions between the music sections (Anthony: 'needs smoother transitions but right thought'). Earlier rounds are in variants_round*.json.

variants.label: Sections blend over 1 second
variants.why: Instead of switching sharply on the cut, each section fades into the next over one second.

variants.label: Sections blend over 2 seconds
variants.why: A longer, gentler blend between sections.

variants.label: One continuous piece, rewritten per section
variants.why: The music model composes one full track, then rewrites each section inside it to fit the story, so the joins are made by the model itself.
